description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between a variable labeled "N" and "AUC (%)" across five distinct data series. The x-axis, labeled "N", features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "AUC (%)", also uses a linear scale, ranging from 75 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The plot contains five solid lines, each distinguished by color and marker shape. The blue line with open circle markers begins at an AUC of approximately 94 at N=1, rises to a plateau of roughly 98.5 between N=5 and N=10, and then declines to end at approximately 94 at N=20. The red line with open square markers starts at roughly 87 at N=1, increases to a peak of approximately 98.5 at N=10, and subsequently decreases to end at roughly 91.5 at N=20. The yellow line with open diamond markers begins at approximately 84 at N=1, rises steadily to a peak of roughly 95 at N=15, and slightly declines to end at approximately 94.5 at N=20. The green line with open star markers starts at roughly 86.5 at N=1, increases to a peak of approximately 94.5 at N=15, and then decreases to end at roughly 92.5 at N=20. Finally, the purple line with open downward-pointing triangle markers begins at approximately 79.5 at N=1, remains relatively steady to roughly 79 at N=5, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 96.5 at N=10, and then declines to end at roughly 82.5 at N=20.
